chicory.notes: Production UI snapshot with browser adapters, static imports and public network defaults. Tests and native platform projects are excluded.

chicory-gallery.notes: native-tests/gallery and test-support/fixtures.ts, adapted for host sessions, browser holds and aliased sealed stand-ins. Built only by vite.gallery.config.ts.

beignet-umbrel.notes: Manager and tests adapted for the Chicory application identity, static build path, local bind defaults and duplicate seed import protection.

chicory-umbrel.notes: Desktop layout and browser motion foundation, adapted to an isolated Electron renderer and local manager.

encryptedStorage.notes: Pinned standalone Node native build with encrypted wallet, guardian and backup databases.

tor.notes: Official Tor Expert Bundle with pinned checksums and upstream license/source notices.
